structure.script_literal: "McBaDe^.But… Would I, if she wanted to?"

translation: Ale… czy zrobiłbym to, gdyby chciała?

source_text: To say I’m disappointed would be an understatement.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.To say I’m disappointed would be an understatement.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.To say I’m disappointed would be an understatement."

translation: Powiedzieć, że jestem rozczarowana, to mało.

source_text: Had I known there was an undercover operation taking place, I’d have kept my distance.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx^.Had I known there was an undercover operation taking place, I’d have kept my distance.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx^.Had I known there was an undercover operation taking place, I’d have kept my distance."

translation: Gdybym wiedziała, że trwa tajna operacja, trzymałabym się od tego z daleka.

source_text: 1Hero, what the hell do you think you’re doing?

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.1Hero, what the hell do you think you’re doing?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.1Hero, what the hell do you think you’re doing?"

translation: 1Hero, co ty, do cholery, wyprawiasz?

source_text: There’s more to this than just the Eclipse Guild…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.There’s more to this than just the Eclipse Guild…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.There’s more to this than just the Eclipse Guild…"

translation: Chodzi o coś więcej niż tylko Gildię Eclipse…

source_text: There are people in danger.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.There are people in danger.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.There are people in danger."

translation: Ludzie są w niebezpieczeństwie.

source_text: We’re on the verge of taking down the Guild. It’s imperative that the operation remains hidden…

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.We’re on the verge of taking down the Guild. It’s imperative that the operation remains hidden…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.We’re on the verge of taking down the Guild. It’s imperative that the operation remains hidden…"

translation: Jesteśmy o krok od rozbicia Gildii. Operacja musi pozostać tajna…

source_text: I understand… but…

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I understand… but…
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I understand… but…"

translation: Rozumiem… ale…

source_text: Do you have any idea what would happen if Nellie gets caught?

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Do you have any idea what would happen if Nellie gets caught?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Do you have any idea what would happen if Nellie gets caught?"

translation: Masz pojęcie, co się stanie, jeśli Nellie wpadnie?

source_text: The operation is a bust?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.The operation is a bust?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.The operation is a bust?"

translation: Operacja zakończy się klapą?

source_text: She gets killed…

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.She gets killed…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.She gets killed…"

translation: Zabiją ją…

source_text: No one is stepping in.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.No one is stepping in.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.No one is stepping in."

translation: Nikt nie zamierza interweniować.

source_text: What if an innocent person gets killed?

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.What if an innocent person gets killed?
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.What if an innocent person gets killed?"

translation: A jeśli zginie niewinny człowiek?

source_text: These aren’t your decisions to make.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.These aren’t your decisions to make.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.These aren’t your decisions to make."

translation: To nie ty o tym decydujesz.

source_text: There are officers posted at the mansion. Perhaps we could do the same for the church.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe^.There are officers posted at the mansion. Perhaps we could do the same for the church.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe^.There are officers posted at the mansion. Perhaps we could do the same for the church."

translation: Przy rezydencji są funkcjonariusze. Może tak samo zrobimy z kościołem.

source_text: Questions are already rising about the lack of search efforts in the forest…

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.Questions are already rising about the lack of search efforts in the forest…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.Questions are already rising about the lack of search efforts in the forest…"

translation: Coraz więcej osób pyta, dlaczego nie prowadzimy poszukiwań w lesie…

source_text: This is getting very messy.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.This is getting very messy.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.This is getting very messy."

translation: Sytuacja robi się coraz bardziej zagmatwana.

source_text: No one has to know about the secret basement in the church. We just need someone watching it to make sure things are safe.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.No one has to know about the secret basement in the church. We just need someone watching it to make sure things are safe.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.No one has to know about the secret basement in the church. We just need someone watching it to make sure things are safe."

translation: Nikt nie musi wiedzieć o tajnej piwnicy w kościele. Wystarczy, że ktoś będzie jej pilnował, żeby upewnić się, że wszystko jest w porządku.

source_text: I’m pulling officers from the mansion. I can reassign one person to keep watch of the church.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.I’m pulling officers from the mansion. I can reassign one person to keep watch of the church.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.I’m pulling officers from the mansion. I can reassign one person to keep watch of the church."

translation: Wycofuję funkcjonariuszy z rezydencji. Mogę przydzielić jedną osobę do pilnowania kościoła.

source_text: Just one?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Just one?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Just one?"

translation: Tylko jedną?

source_text: One is plenty.

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.One is plenty.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.One is plenty."

translation: Jedna wystarczy.

source_text: Yes, Miss Kimura. I think that’ll be fine.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp^.Yes, Miss Kimura. I think that’ll be fine.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp^.Yes, Miss Kimura. I think that’ll be fine."

translation: Tak, panno Kimura. Myślę, że to wystarczy.

source_text: 1Hero, I want you to show the officer the church, but do not mention this secret basement.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.1Hero, I want you to show the officer the church, but do not mention this secret basement.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.1Hero, I want you to show the officer the church, but do not mention this secret basement."

translation: 1Hero, pokaż funkcjonariuszowi kościół, ale nie wspominaj o tajnej piwnicy.

source_text: Just how far into the cave does the Guild bunker reach?

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Just how far into the cave does the Guild bunker reach?
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Just how far into the cave does the Guild bunker reach?"

translation: Jak daleko w głąb jaskini sięga bunkier Gildii?

source_text: Stop asking questions, 1Hero. This isn’t your operation…

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Stop asking questions, 1Hero. This isn’t your operation…
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Stop asking questions, 1Hero. This isn’t your operation…"

translation: Przestań zadawać pytania, 1Hero. To nie twoja operacja…

source_text: Public relations is your focus now.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.Public relations is your focus now.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.Public relations is your focus now."

translation: Teraz skup się na kontaktach z mediami.

source_text: I’m just worried… I know someone who lives very near the cave.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.I’m just worried… I know someone who lives very near the cave.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.I’m just worried… I know someone who lives very near the cave."

translation: Po prostu się martwię… Znam kogoś, kto mieszka blisko jaskini.

source_text: The Guild is not looking to harm civilians.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.The Guild is not looking to harm civilians.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.The Guild is not looking to harm civilians."

translation: Gildia nie zamierza krzywdzić cywilów.

source_text: The best advice I can give to you and your friends is to stay away… stay far away.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.The best advice I can give to you and your friends is to stay away… stay far away.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.The best advice I can give to you and your friends is to stay away… stay far away."

translation: Najlepsza rada, jakiej mogę udzielić tobie i twoim znajomym, brzmi: trzymajcie się z daleka… bardzo daleka.

source_text: Yes, Miss Kimura. We understand.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp^.Yes, Miss Kimura. We understand.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp^.Yes, Miss Kimura. We understand."

translation: Tak, panno Kimura. Rozumiemy.

source_text: You’re on thin ice, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.You’re on thin ice, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.You’re on thin ice, 1Hero."

translation: Jesteś na cienkim lodzie, 1Hero.

source_text: Why the hell did you tell her?

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Why the hell did you tell her?
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Why the hell did you tell her?"

translation: Po co, do cholery, jej o tym powiedziałeś?

source_text: I’m not risking my job so you can play hero for a case that’s not yours.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.I’m not risking my job so you can play hero for a case that’s not yours.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.I’m not risking my job so you can play hero for a case that’s not yours."

translation: Nie będę ryzykować pracy, żebyś mógł bawić się w bohatera w sprawie, która do ciebie nie należy.

source_text: I’m just protecting innocent people.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I’m just protecting innocent people.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I’m just protecting innocent people."

translation: Po prostu chronię niewinnych ludzi.

source_text: Bullshit. This is all about you.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Bullshit. This is all about you.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Bullshit. This is all about you."

translation: Bzdura. Chodzi tylko o ciebie.

source_text: Go to the church. Don’t be late.

structure.raw_value: MeAnEx.Go to the church. Don’t be late.
structure.script_literal: "MeAnEx.Go to the church. Don’t be late."

translation: Jedź do kościoła. Nie spóźnij się.

source_text: Show some professionalism. What’s wrong with you?

structure.raw_value: MeAnDe.Show some professionalism. What’s wrong with you?
structure.script_literal: "MeAnDe.Show some professionalism. What’s wrong with you?"

translation: Zachowuj się profesjonalnie. Co z tobą nie tak?

source_text: Andrea is hiding something.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Andrea is hiding something.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Andrea is hiding something."

translation: Andrea coś ukrywa.

source_text: I’m not surprised.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.I’m not surprised.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.I’m not surprised."

translation: Wcale mnie to nie dziwi.

source_text: She’s got a lot of artwork in her house… She’s still keeping that stolen Rembrandt in her house...

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.She’s got a lot of artwork in her house… She’s still keeping that stolen Rembrandt in her house...
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.She’s got a lot of artwork in her house… She’s still keeping that stolen Rembrandt in her house..."

translation: Ma w domu mnóstwo dzieł sztuki… Wciąż trzyma tam skradzionego Rembrandta…

source_text: Why not keep it at the station?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Why not keep it at the station?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Why not keep it at the station?"

translation: Czemu nie trzyma go na komisariacie?

source_text: I stumbled into a room in her house… It had countless artifacts.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I stumbled into a room in her house… It had countless artifacts.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I stumbled into a room in her house… It had countless artifacts."

translation: Trafiłem przypadkiem na pokój w jej domu… Było tam mnóstwo artefaktów.

source_text: She’s keeping treasures for herself?

structure.raw_value: MeWoDe.She’s keeping treasures for herself?
structure.script_literal: "MeWoDe.She’s keeping treasures for herself?"

translation: Zatrzymuje skarby dla siebie?

source_text: I think she’s been working with the Guild for a long, long time.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I think she’s been working with the Guild for a long, long time.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I think she’s been working with the Guild for a long, long time."

translation: Myślę, że od bardzo dawna współpracuje z Gildią.

source_text: As well as being the police commissioner? You think that’s possible?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.As well as being the police commissioner? You think that’s possible?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.As well as being the police commissioner? You think that’s possible?"

translation: I jednocześnie jest komisarzem policji? Uważasz, że to możliwe?

source_text: Duncan Helmer told me her name is Vayne.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Duncan Helmer told me her name is Vayne.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Duncan Helmer told me her name is Vayne."

translation: Duncan Helmer powiedział mi, że nazywa się Vayne.

source_text: I’ve heard that name before. Wasn’t there a Vayne Stone connected to Charles Wilkes in his hidden file?

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.I’ve heard that name before. Wasn’t there a Vayne Stone connected to Charles Wilkes in his hidden file?
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.I’ve heard that name before. Wasn’t there a Vayne Stone connected to Charles Wilkes in his hidden file?"

translation: Już słyszałem to nazwisko. Czy w tajnych aktach Charlesa Wilkesa nie było czegoś o Vayne Stone?

source_text: Can you see what you can find?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Can you see what you can find?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Can you see what you can find?"

translation: Możesz sprawdzić, co da się znaleźć?

source_text: Not here… It’ll be traced back to me.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Not here… It’ll be traced back to me.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Not here… It’ll be traced back to me."

translation: Nie tutaj… Namierzą, że to ja.

source_text: We have Andrea’s USB drive… Can you do it from your house?

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.We have Andrea’s USB drive… Can you do it from your house?
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.We have Andrea’s USB drive… Can you do it from your house?"

translation: Mamy pendrive Andrei… Możesz to sprawdzić u siebie?

source_text: Yeah… I think I can do it without getting tracked.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.Yeah… I think I can do it without getting tracked.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.Yeah… I think I can do it without getting tracked."

translation: Tak… Chyba uda mi się zrobić to tak, żeby mnie nie namierzyli.

source_text: That goon is not going back to Duncan, but he is probably looking to get a fake passport.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.That goon is not going back to Duncan, but he is probably looking to get a fake passport.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.That goon is not going back to Duncan, but he is probably looking to get a fake passport."

translation: Ten zbir nie wróci do Duncana, ale pewnie spróbuje zdobyć fałszywy paszport.
